b0_schema.jet_order: corrected pt descending; NanoAOD source index for exact ties
b0_schema.normalization: Fit on valid train entries only; mask to zero after standardizing.
b0_schema.tag_validity: finite and in [0,1]; absent, negative or nonfinite values are missing
b0_schema.Qk_validity: finite above -900, or -997 decoded to valid zero; raw fields unchanged
b0_schema.Qk_zero_decision: User approved 2026-10-28 after checking CMSSW_CHARGE producer.
b0_schema.source_uuid: B0SourceUUID0..3: four unsigned 32-bit words, most significant first
b0_schema.source_entry: B0SourceEntry: zero-based entry in the original input NanoAOD
b0_schema.assignment_mask: B0AssignmentMask shared by had_top and lep_top; four distinct real matches and valid W topology

bjet_truth.flavour_rule: hadronFlavour == 5; 0 and 4 are valid non-b flavours
bjet_truth.reco_count: RecoNBJets: all corrected, ID-selected, lepton-cleaned B0 jets before the ten-jet cap
bjet_truth.gen_count: GenNBJets: all input AK4 GenJets in acceptance before the 25-slot output cap
bjet_truth.count_validity: RecoNBJetsValid and GenNBJetsValid; unknown counts are -1
bjet_truth.retained_jet_flag: B0JetIsB{slot}, with B0JetIsBValid{slot}; padding is invalid
bjet_truth.origin: Total b jets, including top, W and radiation; not additional-b-jet counts
bjet_truth.use: Truth metadata only; not inference features or new B0 classification heads
